ao dai: An ao dai is the traditional dress of Vietnamese women consisting of a tunic with long sleeves and panels front and back.
aorist: An aorist is a verb tense in some languages expressing action without indicating its completion or continuation.
aorta: An aorta is the large trunk artery that carries blood from the left ventricle of the heart to branch arteries.
aortic aneurysm: An aortic aneurysm is an aneurysm of the aorta.
aortic arch: An aortic arch is the part of the aorta that arches and turns downward.
aortic orifice: An aortic orifice is the orifice from the lower left chamber of the heart to the aorta.
aortic plexus: An aortic plexus is a plexus of lymph nodes in the lower portion of the abdominal aorta.
aortic stenosis: Aortic stenosis is abnormal narrowing of the aortic valve.
aortic valve: An aortic valve is a semilunar valve between the left ventricle and the aorta.
aortitis: Aortitis is inflammation of the aorta.
aotus: Aotus means the same as genus Aotus.
aotus trivirgatus: Aotus trivirgatus is nocturnal monkey of Central America and South America with large eyes and thick fur.
Aotus trivirgatus means the same as douroucouli.
aoudad: Aoudad is wild sheep of northern Africa.
Aoudad means the same as arui or audad or Barbary sheep.
aoristic: Aoristic means of or relating to the aorist tense.
aortal: Aortal means of or relating to the aorta.
Aortal means the same as aortic.
aortic: Aortic means of or relating to the aorta.
Aortic means the same as aortal.
